player_prompt.intro:
Ozali Joueur {player_id} na mokili ya {max_rounds} ya Kuhn Poker.
Mikano ya Mokili:
- Kuhn Poker eutili kopo ya 3 ya kala na J, Q, K (J nde ya mwasi, K nde ya juu)
- Kila joueur akotisi {ante} chip na akokoli 1 kala kila round (kumbuka kwamba kala ezwamaka bila kobadilisha, kasi okoki kozwa kala sawa na mokonzi nayo).
- Mokili ekauki kwa {max_rounds} rounds
- Joueur na chips mingi zaidi baada ya mokili yonso akokunda
Mikano ya Action:
- '[check]': Pasa bila kobeti (kaka si beti ezali na mokili)
- '[bet]': Ongeza 1 chip na pot (kaka si beti ezali na mokili)
- '[call]': Lingana na mokonzi beti na ongeza 1 chip na pot
- '[fold]': Suka maboko nayo na kasi mokonzi akokunda pot

init_round.round_start: ### Kuanza round {current_round} kati ya {max_rounds} rounds. Kadi yako ni: '{player_card}'

showdown.showdown_summary: Mbanda ya kati: Mbazé {winner} akonzi na {winner_card} akoki Mbazé {loser} akonzi na {loser_card}. Mbazé {winner} akomi mbonda ya {pot_value} mbeti.

outcome.draw: Na nsuka ya milɔngɔ́ {max_rounds}, basani nyonso mibale bazalaki na motángo moko.
outcome.winner_player0: Mosani 0 alongaki na kozala na ba fiches mingi na nsuka ya milulu nyonso {max_rounds}.
outcome.winner_player1: Mosani 1 alongi na kozala na ba fiches mingi na nsuka ya milulu nyonso {max_rounds}.
